briefdescription.para: Given a list of metric attributes, computes and returns their sum.

simplesect.para: See the sum operator for metric attributes for the conditions under which a sum of metric attributes may be correctly computed. If the metric name of a metric from attr_list does not match attr_name, the result metricAttr will be empty.

briefdescription.para: Returns the filename component of a Sg_File_Info object, or the empty string if it cannot be determined.
Returns the line number component of a Sg_File_Info object, or 0 if it cannot be determined.
Checks if a given Sage node already has a metric attribute with the specified name and returns a pointer to this attribute if so, or NULL otherwise.
Implements metric propagation support for Sage III trees.

This propagator pushes metric attributes upward in the tree, so that all scopes have a metric attribute. The propagation procedure uses synthesized attributes, computing an attribute at a given node by summing the attribute over the immediate child nodes.

detaileddescription.para: Only certain types of nodes will have attributes. These nodes are specializations of templated member function, MetricScopePropagator::eval ().

simplesect.para: Metric propagation as implemented in MetricScopePropagator is only approximation to the "true" metric value at a given node since the computation is flow-insensitive.
